description: Zero-dependency Python library to strip the UTF-8 byte order mark (BOM) from strings, bytes, binary streams and files. Python port of the strip-bom npm package.
rules: Import from strip_bom: strip_bom (str), strip_bom_buffer (bytes), strip_bom_stream (binary file object), strip_bom_file (path).
strip_bom_buffer only removes the BOM when the bytes are valid UTF-8; strip_bom raises TypeError for bytes input.
